text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: My name—I received it from the land where I was born. The name is Kentucky—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Kentucky Colt, desu!

text_block_list.name: Actor playing Gunslinger
text_block_list.text: Heh, not a bad look in your eyes. As for me, around these parts folks call me "Lone Wolf Joe"—

text_block_list.name: Actor playing Gunslinger
text_block_list.text:
...Mm, sorry. Cut. I can't seem to grasp the feel of a "lone wolf"...
Director, could you tell me what kind of acting you're looking for?

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Ah, right...
Uhh, well............ L-Let's take a short break!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
A lone wolf... How do I convey that...?
Ugh, the image is right there in my head, but...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Director, nice idea!
Then let's all go together~♪

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: Huh... Go...?

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: T-Taiki-san?! Are you listening?! Now really isn't the time to fool around at the zoo—

text_block_list.name: Zoo Wolf
text_block_list.text: Awoooooooooo...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow, a wolf howl, desu!
Seeing it in real life makes it look even cooler!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...Ah, yeah... Exactly, that's it.
It has that loneliness, that gritty solemn feel...

text_block_list.name: Actor playing Gunslinger
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see now...! Alright, I can picture the role!
Now I can act it out without hesitation!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: What?! The painted backdrop broke...?! Without that scenery, the next scene can't...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Time for a craft contest, right?!
Let's hammer away~♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
OK, done! So, how is it?
Does the scenery behind us look properly set up?

text_block_list.name: Art Staff
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! You mean backdrop, right? Yep, perfect!
It might be because we all pooled our ideas together to make it!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
It really is...
Al-Alright... Let's resume filming!

text_block_list.name: Construction Worker
text_block_list.text:
Ah, filming a movie?! Mm-ngh!
Sorry about this, but we've got construction scheduled here.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Then that's the start of an adventure!
Searching for a new location, here we go!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
An adventure... Ah! That park on the way here!
The atmosphere was great, why don't we go explore there...?!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: I-It's a wraaap~~!! Man, I was full of anxiety and troubles kept popping up, but—

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
It turned out to be such a fulfilling day!
And it's all thanks to you, Taiki-san!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh! Thanks to me, desuka?

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
No matter the situation, you gave it your all and looked like you were having so much fun...
Thanks to that, I was able to keep moving forward too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes! "Seize the Day"
—That is my motto, after all~♪

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: ? "Seize... the Day"... is it?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: It's a phrase that means "Live in the moment", desu!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I learned this spirit back at the ranch where I was born and raised.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The ranch is relaxing and carefree! But...
Depending on the weather and season, it can get very heavy.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
When it's cold or rainy, there are times you can't go outside for days on end.
Are those very bad days? ...No!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Even when it's cold, the sheep huddling together look so happy!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: My family too, on rainy days we dance in front of the fireplace, or do some knitting and enjoy ourselves!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: If you spend every single day fully absorbed in having fun like that, lovely days will just keep going on!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Make "now" happy, not the future or the past!
That is "Seize the Day", desu!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: ! I see, the reason today's shoot went so well was also because we poured our hearts into the "now"...

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: That day... that smile I saw when I offered you the role, it carried those very same feelings all along.

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
Taiki-san...! Let's keep up the great work with filming tomorrow!
Let's give it our all and immerse ourselves completely!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while taking a walk for a change of pace—

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: Taiki-san, regarding the line for this next scene, please give it a bit of a melancholic feel!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Okay!
Understood, leave it to me!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's Trainer-san who came to the party, desu ne!
Yes! I am enjoying myself so much!
choice_data_list: You really have a talent for acting!
You really have a talent for acting!
Is there anything I can help with?
Is there anything I can help with?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's Trainer-san who came to the party, desu ne!
Yes! I am enjoying myself so much!
choice_data_list: You really have a talent for acting!
You really have a talent for acting!
Is there anything I can help with?
Is there anything I can help with?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Thanks to the director's guidance,
I'm making rapid progress!
Now, please watch my acting!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
There are two kinds of Horse Girls in this world——
Those who dig for carrots, and those who eat them!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu~! You have a keen eye, don't you~?
Why not join us as a staff member?
Making movies is super fun, you know!
choice_data_list: If you'll have me, I'd love to!
If you're fine with me, I'd love to!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I ended up helping with the movie production
as a backstage odd-job worker.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
There are two kinds of Horse Girls in this world——
Those who dig for carrots, and those who eeet them—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I flubbed my line……!
But failure is the mother of success!! I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the movie starring Taiki Shuttle
was safely completed and received great acclaim.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, we just happened to be recruiting
an extra for the role of a cactus!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After negotiating with Taiki Shuttle and the director,
I somehow managed to secure a role
as a human extra instead.
